generic_domain.justification: Decentralized Learning is the most generic domain as it broadly encompasses both centralized training with decentralized execution and pure decentralized training approaches. It provides a foundational framework that includes methods where models can either be trained in a centralized manner but executed across multiple nodes (centralized training, decentralized execution) or fully trained in a decentralized setting without relying on a central server. These narrower concepts fall under the umbrella of Decentralized Learning.
